risks: Figure-text contradictions: F8 TGA shows the 0% control with the LOWEST mass loss (~10%) while text says TiO2 lowers mass loss; abstract/conclusion wear rates (3.45e-5 -> 1.12e-5 at 40%) disagree with F9/text (1.395e-3 -> 2.63e-4 at 50%); abstract friction 0.36->0.29 vs F9 0.397->0.284
Methods says ball-on-disk tribometer, Results says pin-on-disc; F7 text says same magnification but bars read X100/X200; panel labels 'Ti2O'
only one independent quantitative law family usable (Bragg vs external anatase lattice, essentially phase ID with printed peak positions); TGA mass balance violated by the curves
bulk density/porosity/water absorption only in Table 2 (no panel) - porosity agreement and density rule-of-mixtures not supportable from figures
F6b and F9 print values on bars; text repeats UCS values (contamination for recompute items)
F8 is six small dual-axis panels under one figure id; F10m/F11 dossier ids are auto-split (F11 mislabelled micrograph in dossier)
multi-instrument (6) but no two instruments measure the same physical quantity -> no agreement law
